title: [C12T2] - Islip town center development plans
prompt: The maps below show the centre of a small town called Islip as it is now, and plans for its development. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the current layout of Islip town centre and proposed plans for its development.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the plans show a major transformation, with the most significant change being the creation of a pedestrian-only area and construction of a dual carriageway bypass.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Currently, Islip town centre features a main road running east-west through its heart, with shops on both sides. Housing areas are positioned south of the main road, while a school is located in the southwest and a park in the southeast. The area north of the shops is countryside.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Under the proposed plan, the main road will be replaced by a dual carriageway bypass, converting the current road into a pedestrians-only zone. This area will accommodate a new bus station, shopping centre, and car park from west to east respectively. The northern shops will be removed for these facilities, while southern shops will be retained. New housing developments are planned for both northeastern and southeastern areas. The school will remain but expand, while the park will stay in its current location but be reduced in size due to the dual carriageway construction.
